data: Amazon's operating income was $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023 and $68.6 billion in fiscal 2024, an increase of about 86%. I can't reliably confirm the fiscal 2025 full-year figure, so I can't give you the 2023-to-2025 percentage change with confidence. If you share Amazon's FY2025 10-K or the Q4 2025 earnings release, I can calculate the change from those numbers.
